caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device consisting of a rectangular base with a natural wood grain texture rendered in shades of brown. Mounted on the base are four vertically oriented, turned wooden columns, each cylindrical with decorative knobbed tops and bases. Attached near the center of the base is a large circular wheel with pronounced wooden grain and shading, supported by two of the columns. To the left side of the wheel is a hand crank composed of a horizontal handle and a jointed arm, all depicted in the same wood tone. On the opposite side of the wheel, a small mechanical assembly with two pronged metal tips extends outward, supported by columns. The composition is set against a plain, beige background, and the objects are rendered in realistic detail, showing the curvature, shadows, and color variations of the polished wood. There is a small artist signature and date “SAM W. FORD Del. 1901” in the lower right corner.
title: Apple Peeler
